All six tools start on for every story. Entity tools can change persistent world state; dice and image calls can add cost. Turn off any tool independently before writing.

ENTITY
Look up entities
The narrator can read characters and other world state.
Create entities
The narrator can add persistent characters, places, and objects.
Update entities
The narrator can change persistent world details.
Adjust attributes
The narrator can change entity stats. Manual edits remain available when off.
DICE
Roll uncertain outcomes
The narrator may give a chance or reference up to two stored attributes. Rolls read stats but never change them.
IMAGE
Illustrate scenes
